regime.skew: put-rich, +1.42 at 25 delta - rebought from -0.39 on 05 Sep but still half the +2.90 of 02 Sep
regime.label: Dealer gamma doubles to +10,068 as the future runs 21 points into the 1080-1100 call block: a damping ceiling above, an air pocket below 1070
evidence: Net chain GEX is +10,068, up 94% from +5,182 on 05 Sep and 5.1x the near-flat +199 of 03 Sep - the highest-signal event of the week is that dealers flipped from amplifier to dampener in three sessions.

Per-strike net GEX is +3,388 at the 1080 ATM (the largest single positive on the board), +2,589 at 1090 and +4,188 at the 1100 call wall, against -1,876 at 1050, -810 at 1030 and a cumulative -4,182 by 1070 - hedging brakes the rally above spot and accelerates any slide below 1070 from the same hinge.

Cumulative GEX only crosses zero between 1080 (-794) and 1090 (+1,795), an interpolated flip of about 1083, so spot 1079.4 is straddling it with roughly 4 points of slack: the long-gamma cushion is real above but not yet paid for below.

ATM IV 12.91% is the lowest of the last six sessions (range 12.86-14.09) and the 1-sigma day is 8.78 points (0.81%), while today's put/call volume ratio fell to 1.18 from 1.48 - the rally is running on lighter flow and flat vol, not a max-pain failure signature.

S50U26.today_summary: The future added 7.2 points to 1079.4, a second straight advance for +16.9 over two sessions, and now sits 9.4 points above a max pain that has been stuck at 1070 for three of the last four days. Net dealer gamma doubled to +10,068 and is concentrated in the 1080-1100 block (+3,388 at the 1080 ATM, +4,188 at the 1100 call wall), which turns that band into a damping ceiling rather than a breakout runway. Below 1070 the picture inverts: cumulative GEX is -4,182 at 1070 and -4,114 by 1050, so a give-back is hedged with the move, not against it. ATM IV compressed to 12.91%, a six-session low, with the 25-delta skew at +1.42 as puts are partially rebought after being dumped into Friday's rally.
what_changed: Net chain GEX doubled to +10,068 from +5,182 on 05 Sep and +3,492 on 01 Sep - dealers built the long-gamma cushion into the 1080-1100 band as price arrived there.
The gamma flip fell to 1090 (interpolated 1083) from 1110 on 04 Sep and 1140 on 03 Sep, and spot 1079.4 now straddles it instead of sitting 30-80 points below.

1090 calls added 188 OI on 366 lots, the day's largest call build and heaviest call volume, while 1070 and 1080 calls shed 208 and 173 OI on 175 and 331 lots - short calls were bought back as the future ran through them.

Put/call volume fell to 1.18 from 1.48 even as the future gained 7.2 points, and 1050 puts took 400 lots for +70 OI - protection flow is lightening in aggregate but the near put wall is being reinforced.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Spot has travelled +21.1 points from 1058.3 on 03 Sep to 1079.4 while max pain stayed anchored at 1070, widening the spot-to-pain gap from -1.7 to +9.4 - price ran away from the structure rather than the structure following price. Over the same five sessions ATM IV compressed 1.18 points from 14.09% to 12.91% and the 1-sigma day narrowed from 9.04 to 8.78 points, so the market is paying less for a move after a larger one. The 1100 call wall (2,738 OI) and the 1050 near put wall (2,012 OI) have not migrated a single strike in six sessions, but the delta bands slid up 20-40 points (put 10-delta 1020 to 1040, call 25-delta 1090 to 1100), which is the distribution re-centring inside a fixed OI frame. The 25-delta skew whipsawed +2.90 on 02 Sep to -0.39 on 05 Sep and back to +1.42 today, marking protection being dumped into the rally and then partly rebought at higher strikes. The decisive delta is dealer posture: GEX went from +199 on 03 Sep to +10,068 today, converting the 1080-1100 zone from neutral terrain into the damping band that should cap this leg.

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1060 / 1040
strategies.rationale: Sells the 25-delta band edge with the 1050 near put wall (2,012 OI, 400 lots and +70 OI today, so a live level rather than stale OI) sitting inside the spread, and leans toward a max pain 9.4 points below spot in a long-gamma, 12.91% IV tape.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus net credit received, per spread. Defined risk is not risk-free - the full 20 points can be lost.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1050, the near put wall, which also drops price into the pocket where cumulative GEX is -4,114.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1040P / 1060P x 1110C / 1130C
strategies.rationale: Places both short strikes outside the live near-money walls with the call side deliberately lifted above the 1100 wall, because +4,188 GEX at 1100 and +1,696 at 1110 mean dealer hedging should decelerate any push into that band rather than let it run.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus net credit, on the breached side only. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so size is the control, not accuracy.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1110 or below 1050; either breach means price has left the 1050-1100 OI frame that has held for six sessions.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1070 / 1040
strategies.rationale: Buys the max-pain strike that caps the short-gamma pocket - cumulative GEX is -4,182 at 1070 and -4,114 by 1050 - while ATM IV at 12.91% is a six-session low, so the insurance against a hedged-with-the-move give-back is priced near the cheapest it has been this month.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the net debit paid, capped at the premium outlay; max value 30 points at or below 1040.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1090, the gamma flip, which restores the damping cushion and drains the thesis.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is a 1070-1100 range while dealers hold +10,068 of net gamma, with the 1-sigma day at only 8.78 points and both walls unmoved for six sessions; the 1080-1100 block should decelerate further upside rather than fuel it. The asymmetry is one-sided: above 1100 the cushion is strongest (+4,188 there, cumulative +5,983), so breakouts get damped, while below 1070 cumulative GEX is -4,182 and hedging turns pro-cyclical toward the 1050 wall. Invalidation of the pin read is a close below 1050 on expanding volume and rising IV - that is the max-pain-failure signature, and today's falling 1.18 put/call volume ratio and flat 12.91% IV show it is not present yet.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended or sized. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070-1100 magnet as a tendency, not a guarantee. At 21 DTE ATM gamma has not yet steepened into the expiry regime, the 910 put wall (16,322 OI, 18 lots and -12 OI today) is stale structural inventory rather than active support, and macro or news flow can override the entire option structure outright.
